notes_for_editor: The 1916 build and 1967 destruction agree across all three tower pages; all trace to Kresek, so they are one source in substance. The brief had no build year, so 1916 is added as a new event, not a correction. Design conflict: cab (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts) vs covered platform (Rex's page). New photo: the U of I postcard (approx. 1920, NoC-US). A Potlatch Historical Society photo appears only in a search snippet of a Facebook post and is not cited. A Facebook group post mentions a summer lookout's cabin and a c.1950 date, but only its title was readable, so no staffing is recorded. No source describes the site today. Not merged with East Gold Hill (us-id-east-gold-hill). The postcard page does not name West Gold Hill; it is tied to this site by coordinates (46.967853, -116.793283, about 50 m from the FFLA listing at 46.96789, -116.79263), so the story says so.
